message.content:
**The latest stable Go release is 1.27.3, released 2026-10-19.** It is a minor revision of Go 1.27.

I checked this on the official Go release history page (https://go.dev/doc/devel/release). It lists go1.27.0 as released 2026-08-19. It lists go1.27.3 as released 2026-10-19, with security fixes to `crypto/x509`. The Go 1.27 release notes (https://go.dev/doc/go1.27) describe 1.27 as the latest major release. A third-party tracker agrees on 1.27.3, dated 2026-10-20, which is one day off the official date.

Some of the other search results were out of date or wrong:
- Wikipedia still lists 1.27.1 (1 September 2026), and a GitHub pull request says the same.
- VersionLog labels 1.26.10 as "Latest Stable" and calls 1.27.3 a pre-release. The official page treats 1.27 as a normal stable major release.

The 1.26 line is still supported. Its latest patch is go1.26.10, also released 2026-10-19.
